job.job_description:
Experience in AI/ML engineering, with at least 3+ years in LLM-based solutions.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with pro-code agent development.
Hands-on experience with multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Swarm).
Deep understanding of LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool integration.
Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and knowledge graphs.
Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms with a focus on agent deployment and orchestration Azure Cloud - Azure AI services, Kubernetes, and agent orchestration pipelines.
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - AI/ML services, Vertex AI, containerized agent deployment.
Proficiency with Google AI Developer Kit (ADK) for building and integrating AI solutions.
Knowledge of observability tools for AI agents and evaluation frameworks.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in fast-paced, innovative environments.

Location - Pune, Chennai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, Gurugram, Coimbatore, Noida
